source.name: Anthropic API list prices (first-party Claude API)
source.retrieved_via: the model/pricing table cached on 2026-06-24 in the claude-api reference bundled with Claude Code; NOT re-checked against the live page

notes: Only route=direct is priced. Bedrock and Vertex AI have their own price lists; OpenRouter and proxies add their own margins. Those records get cost_usd_server = null (reason route_not_covered).
cache_write uses the 5-minute TTL rate (1.25x input). Transcripts do not separate 1-hour cache writes (2x input), so runs that used them are under-estimated.
Not modelled: batch discounts, fast mode, regional or long-context premiums, tool-use surcharges (e.g. web search).
Model ids match exactly or as a prefix followed by '-', '@' or '[' (longest entry wins), so dated snapshot ids resolve to their family.
